sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section connects the verse "Light is sown for the righteous" to the concept of self-nullification and mesiras nefesh, which, like physical seed decay, reveals the infinite power of Ein Sof.

translations.translation: And this can be connected to what is said in the chapter of Tehillim
that we begin to recite on the 12th of Tammuz of this year
"Light is sown for the righteous, and for the upright of heart, joy."
And the Tzemach Tzedek, in his notes on Tehillim, brings
what our sages said in the Midrash,
that "Light is sown for the righteous" is the light that was created on the first day and was hidden away for the righteous for the future to come.
(And through this, "and for the upright of heart, joy,"
who are the righteous whose hearts are in their own control.)
And he notes: "Light is sown," specifically,
sowing specifically.
And it is like physical sowing,
where there must be decay of the seed,
for this specifically awakens the power of growth in the earth.
For the power of growth in the earth is the power of Ein Sof,
and through the growth, there is a revelation of the power of Ein Sof
(as understood from Iggeret HaKodesh, chapter 20).
And so it is in spirituality,
that through the service of self-nullification and mesiras nefesh, one reaches Ein Sof, which is above the chain of descent.
And as explained in the maamarim
on the verse,
"Those who come, Yaakov shall take root, Israel shall blossom and flower, and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit,"
which is the service of Torah and mitzvos with self-nullification
(like the matter of sowing),
behold, specifically through this, "they shall fill the face of the world with fruit" is the revelation of the power of Ein Sof,
and as also explained in the continuation of "Kol HaNeheneh" of 5652.
And it is like what was stated above, that specifically through the service of trials, one reaches the level of a miracle within a miracle,
His Essence and Being, blessed be He.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through Torah, mitzvos, and mesiras nefesh during trials, the "horns of the righteous" are raised, representing a miracle within a miracle, higher than the revelation of the Exodus.

translations.translation: And this is also what is written,
"And all the horns of the wicked I will cut down; the horns of the righteous shall be raised up."
And it is brought in the Midrash,
"There are ten horns that the Holy One, blessed be He, gave to Israel... when Israel sinned, they were taken from them and given to the nations..."
For the matter of a horn and elevation applies only to Israel.
But because of our sins
(at least the matter of sin is a matter of deficiency, as it is written,
"I and Shlomo my son are sinners"),
we were exiled from our land,
and when one rises, the other falls,
and then the horns of the nations exist and the horns of Israel are cut down,
may it be spared.
But through the study of Torah and the fulfillment of positive commandments and the guarding of negative commandments,
and primarily through the service of mesiras nefesh in the matter of trials,
and especially in the generation of the heels of Moshiach, when the service is most difficult as above,
for this service is from the aspect of a miracle within a miracle in the soul, as above,
behold, through this, "the horns of the righteous shall be raised up,"
meaning not only that the horns exist
(through which "all the horns of the wicked I will cut down"),
but rather that they are in a manner of "shall be raised up,"
a miracle within a miracle,
the level of the "end of the right" which is above the right of Arich Anpin.
This is the innovation of the future redemption over the redemption from Egypt,
for the Exodus from Egypt was through the arms of Arich Anpin,
which are two levels,
the right arm and the left arm,
but "the horns of the righteous shall be raised up" is the right of Atik.
And its parallel in mitzvos is the mitzvos that are not dependent on a person's will,
as above,
and on the contrary,
the desire for prominence, etc., as above, confuses the fulfillment of these mitzvos.
And in service, it is the service that is above the measure of the intellect and emotions,
which stands firmly against the concealments and coverings and pays no attention to them,
the level of the aforementioned "lot."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the service of the "lot," the land is divided, referring to settlement, and that every Jew has a "lot" in his soul that can be revealed instantly, connecting to the inheritance of the Land of Israel.

translations.translation: And behold, through the service of the aforementioned "lot," the land will be divided,
meaning that in addition to the conquest of the land,
the land will be divided,
which is the matter of settlement.
And as our sages said,
"And you shall inherit it and dwell in it,"
meaning after the seven years of conquest and the seven years of division,
and then the primary matter of fulfilling the mitzvos dependent on the land began.
And so it is regarding the land above,
the World to Come,
which is the reward for mitzvos,
for that all of Israel have a portion in the World to Come is from the aspect that there is the level of the "lot," "You support my lot," for each and every Jew.
And even one in whom, openly, no matter of good and holiness is apparent,
has a level of "lot" in his soul,
and on the contrary, it is possible that specifically with him there is a most holy soul.
And from this, he can transform himself in one hour and one moment to be in the ultimate perfection of holiness.
And this will be understood according to what is explained in many places
regarding the statement of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai,
"I do not know on which path they are leading me,"
for even though his service was in a most elevated manner, as explained in many places,
nevertheless he said, "I do not know," etc.,
because he was uncertain whether his service, from the aspect of his essential soul
(the level of the aforementioned "lot"),
was as it should be,
for there is no proof from his service in the revealed powers to the level that is above intellect and emotion.
And the measure of good is greater, etc.,
for also with one in whose revealed powers no matter of good is seen,
there is no proof from this at all regarding the level above this,
and especially since regarding each and every Jew it is said,
"Fortunate are we... how pleasant is our lot,"
behold, it is clear that there is within him a very great soul,
and he has the power to transform and overcome, etc., even if, heaven forbid, there was concealment and hiding of his intellect and his midos throughout the days of his life,
like Rabba bar Avuha who acquired his world in one hour.
And just as it is regarding the division of the land above,
the World to Come,
which is from the aspect of the "lot" that exists for each and every Jew,
so it is regarding the matter of conquest and division of the land in its simple sense,
which is from the aspect of the "lot" that exists for each and every Jew,
therefore the Land of Israel belongs to the Children of Israel in an eternal covenant, "to your seed after you, an everlasting possession,"
which is an inheritance for us from Avraham
(because of truth, forever),
from the Covenant Between the Parts.
The land of the seven nations,
and in addition to this, "the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,"
which is the land of the Keni, Kenizi, and Kadmoni,
as specified in the Covenant Between the Parts, and even more,
as explained in the Midrashim of our sages,
that "the L-rd your G-d will expand your border" is to an expansion without measure.
